name: Eicher Motors Limited
remarksWeb: 1. The % of voting rights, shares and dividend rights held by Ms. Tara Lal, Mr. Siddhartha Vikram Lal and Ms. Simran Lal, the Significant Beneficial Owners, as mentioned in SBO table, comprises of those held by them directly as well as indirectly in Eicher Motors Limited. The Simran Siddhartha Tara Benefit Trust, the Registered Owner, holds 43.83% of shares in Eicher Motors Limited.  2. Mr. Vikram Lal, Mrs. Anita Lal, Ms. Tara Lal, Ms. Simran Lal, Ms. Natasha Jamal, Mrs. Sunita Jamal, Mr. Siddartha Lal, Mr. Raul Rai, Mr. Ravi Prakash and Ms. Mahima Puri are acting as Trustee in one or more of the Trusts mentioned under the Promoter and Promoter Group category. 3.  Trustees of the THE SIMRAN SIDDHARTHA TARA BENEFIT TRUST are Mr. Vikram Lal, Mrs. Anita Lal, Ms. Simran Lal, Mr. Siddhartha Lal & Ms. Tara Lal. 4. Under SBO, % of shares and voting rights held by Mr. Siddhartha Vikram Lal includes those held through SIDDHARTHA LAL TRUST also. 5. Under SBO, % of shares and voting rights held by Ms. Tara Lal includes those held through TARA LAL TRUST also. 6. ARANYANI FOUNDATION has become part of Promoter Group w.e.f 26th June, 2026.
